_doc: Item mod families (Documentation/ITEM_GENERATION_REDESIGN_2026-11-14.md). Generated by Scripts/build-item-mods.py, then hand-edited. pool: material|stat|mechanic|action. kind: stat (StatBonus of statType), mod (clone of the Modifications/PrefixMaterialQuality template), suffix (clone of a StatBonuses row), slots (+combo strip slots). Tier: keyword, min/max value, level (item level needed; slotLevel overrides per slot), weight, maxRarity (highest item rarity that can roll it; 'Common' tiers are the common-only highs), slots (optional per-tier slot limit).
